summary.text: Derek Lewis is a Republican state representative who has represented District 90 since 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Derek Lewis was born in London, Kentucky.
He earned a bachelor of science in accounting and communication arts from the University of the Cumberlands and a master of business administration from Western Kentucky University.
His career experience includes working as a small business owner and as a pharmacy and residential real-estate business manager.
He has been a member of the EKCEP Workforce Investment Board, the Hyden-Leslie County Chamber of Commerce, and the NRA.
In the 2025-2026 session Lewis serves on the House Banking and Insurance, Judiciary, and Transportation committees.
